gloss: labor cost; processing fee; wages for work

definitions.gloss: labor cost; processing fee; wages for work done
definitions.explanation: The charge for labor or craftsmanship in manufacturing, repair, or processing work. Distinct from material costs, this covers the cost of the human work involved.

examples.japanese: {工賃|こうちん}は{別途|べっと}かかります。
examples.english: There will be a separate labor charge.

examples.japanese: {部品代|ぶひんだい}と{工賃|こうちん}を{合|あ}わせて{一万円|いちまんえん}だった。
examples.english: The parts and labor together came to 10,000 yen.

examples.japanese: この{修理|しゅうり}は{工賃|こうちん}が{高|たか}いので、{新|あたら}しいものを{買|か}った{方|ほう}がいいかもしれない。
examples.english: The labor cost for this repair is so high that it might be better to buy a new one.

notes:
Commonly encountered when getting things repaired or custom-made. On invoices and estimates, {工賃|こうちん} is typically listed separately from {材料費|ざいりょうひ} (material costs) or {部品代|ぶひんだい} (parts costs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工賃|こうちん}がかかる: labor costs are incurred
- {工賃|こうちん}{込|こ}み: labor included (in the price)
- {工賃|こうちん}{別|べつ}: labor charged separately
- {工賃|こうちん}を{支払|しはら}う: to pay the labor charge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手間賃|てまちん}: fee for labor/effort — more informal, emphasizes the trouble or effort involved
- {人件費|じんけんひ}: personnel costs — broader term for all costs related to employing people
- {加工賃|かこうちん}: processing fee — specifically for the cost of processing or manufacturing
